  • Reference

    Rw

    Rw provides fast piecewise (“segmented”) regression with one or several break points, where the slope is shared by all segments and each segment has its own intercept, plus a small helper to remove the seasonal cycle of a series.

    The regression routines work directly on a design matrix built with stats::.lm.fit(), so they are cheap enough to be called thousands of times while searching for the best break points.

    Installation

    You can install the development version of Rw like so:

    remotes::install_github("pengyuyan1234567/Rw")

    Example 

    library(Rw)

set.seed(1)
X <- seq_len(20)
Y <- c(seq_len(10), seq_len(10) + 15) + rnorm(20, sd = 0.4)

## one break point, shared slope
fit <- LS_OneBreak(Y, X, Ic = 10)
round(fit$coef, 3)
#> [1] -0.061  1.021  4.840
fit$SSE
#> [1] 2.454179

## several break points
LS_MultiBreaks(Y, X, Ips = c(10, 20))$coef

## remove the seasonal cycle
RemoveSeasonal(y = c(11, 12, 13, 21, 22, 23), t_mmdd = c(101, 101, 101, 102, 102, 102))
#> $mu
#> 101 102
#>  12  22
#>
#> $anomaly
#> [1] -1  0  1 -1  0  1

    Documentation

    The model equations, the design decisions and a walk-through of the four functions are written up as a Typst note in docs/note_01.typ:

    typst compile --root . docs/note_01.typ
